<thought>We need to find templates that form a sulfonamide (N‑S bond) from a sulfonyl chloride (breaking S‑Cl). The available functional group list includes "sulfonamides" but not "sulfonyl chloride", so we omit the broken functional group filter and just search by the bond changes and the formed functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
